style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, cute satire with comic horror
motion_rule: EVERY second something big crosses or fills the lens. Nothing comes to rest: the tags never settle, each slams on and springs off while the coat builds
camera_moves: the camera never rests. 0.0-0.8 a low push-in through the grass straight at her face; 2.0 a whip pan after the goat; 5.9-7.0 a full orbit around her, the meadow and the peaks wheeling behind; 8.6 a hard pull-back; 9.3 a push into her eyes
character: a fluffy white alpaca, long neck, absurd fringe, buck teeth, huge eyes, stand-up comic energy
cast: the GOAT: grey-brown, big horns, square yellow pupils, an open fan of paper coupons and a pan flute he never stops playing; he gallops past the lens
props: TAGS: price tags with butterfly wings, each a different bright colour — scarlet, lime, turquoise, gold — with a big embossed currency sign, no words. FLOWERS: white and yellow, the tags lift off them
prop_continuity: bright butterflies until 7.7; then each becomes a PIRANHA — wings stay, the body swells into a goggle-eyed fish head with small sharp teeth; from 8.6 they stay bitten in
environment: sunlit Swiss alpine meadow, flowers, snowy peaks behind
lighting: blazing alpine noon, hard sun, crisp shadows; the horror is in the teeth

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: bright confident female voice, even 4.4 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: 0.8-3.35 is ONE unbroken phrase, no break at 1.95 or 2.65; 5.0-7.0 is ONE unbroken phrase, the words run across the 5.9 boundary; voiceless after 7.0
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: a light fairground pan flute all clip, wind in the grass, a sharp CLICK at 8.6, then the flute alone

timeline.a: silent. HOOK: the camera charges low through the grass and she drops her buck-toothed face into it until the teeth almost touch the lens, then a hoof slams her chest
she rocks her whole body at the lens while the GOAT gallops in from the right, huge and close, his coupon fan swinging
no break. The camera whips right after the goat and his fan wipes the frame
no break. She throws her head up and swings around after him, her flank wiping the frame
silent. The meadow erupts: a swarm of BRIGHT tags lifts off the flowers into the lens, blanking it twice, wings beating
one scarlet tag lands flat on the lens, covers the whole frame, then flutters off her nose as she rears up
no break, the phrase runs on. The camera orbits her a full turn while the swarm rams her from three sides, every tag slapping on and springing off, the coat building out of pure churn
silent. She spins on the spot inside the coat, tags streaming off her flanks and hauled back in, one gold tag beating at the lens
silent. Every tag turns at once: bodies swell into goggle-eyed PIRANHA heads, jaws opening, the whole coat churning like a wave
silent. CLICK: every piranha bites at once, she jolts up on all fours and the camera hauls back as the coloured swarm bursts outward
silent. The camera drives into her eyes as they blow wide in comic horror, the grin frozen, piranhas raining past

must_appear: multicoloured butterfly tags, tags covering her like a coat, every tag turning into a goggle-eyed piranha with teeth, her eyes wide in comic horror
negative_prompt: letters, cyrillic, readable text, subtitles, watermark, night, dusk, dark scene, people, hands, live insects, blood, a second alpaca, slow motion, the alpaca standing still, a motionless coat of tags, tags coming to rest on her, a talking head with an empty frame, accented Russian
